definitions.explanation: An organized association of students, especially the student government of a university or specialized school. Handles student-life activities, club support, and the school festival. The pre-university counterpart is {生徒会|せいとかい}.

examples.japanese: {学生会|がくせいかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{所属|しょぞく}→所属：12750_shozoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I belong to the student association.

examples.japanese: {学生会|がくせいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Elections for student association officers were held.

examples.japanese: {学生会|がくせいかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The student association is in charge of running the university festival.

notes:
⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ (student, typically university level) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (association). Naming for university student government varies: some schools use {学生会|がくせいかい}, others use ⟦{自治会|じちかい}→自治会：22488_jichikai⟧ ('self-government association'). Below university level, the standard term is ⟦{生徒会|せいとかい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学生会|がくせいかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役員|やくいん}→役員：11329_yakuin⟧: student association officer
- {学生会|がくせいかい}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: student association activities
- {学生会|がくせいかい}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: student association election

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生徒会|せいとかい}→生徒会：05378_seitokai⟧: student council (junior high / high school)
- ⟦{児童会|じどうかい}→児童会：28836_jidoukai⟧: elementary school student council
- ⟦{自治会|じちかい}→自治会：22488_jichikai⟧: self-government association — also a common name for university student government, and for local residents' associations
